author: Emmanuel A. Otchere
description: Curated system-archetype to anchor-metric bridge for the CR-IS-CAT-01C-P5 measured_by registry population. Each of the 34 vendor-neutral P4 system archetypes maps to one anchor metric record of the pinned dea-catalog-metrics snapshot. Selection criteria: the anchor is the canonical operational or outcome measure of the archetype, vendor-neutral, and present in the vendored metric snapshot. Applied deterministically by scripts/generate_p5_registry.py (per G-10).

system_anchor_metrics.rationale: ERP batch operations are the operational heartbeat of the ERP system archetype; batch job success measures the reliability of its period-end and mass-processing functions.
The CRM system archetype exists to steward customer relationships; the customer satisfaction score is its canonical outcome metric.
Core banking executes payment posting and settlement; payment success rate measures the reliability of its transactional functions.
The EHR system archetype stewards clinical records at the point of care; the medication error rate is the canonical patient-safety outcome measure of record integrity.
The IAM platform archetype fulfils access requests across the identity lifecycle; fulfilment cycle time measures its core operational flow.
The HCM system archetype runs the hire-to-retire cycle; performance review completion is the canonical periodic HCM process metric.
The e-commerce platform archetype converts browsing into orders; checkout completion rate measures its revenue-critical funnel reliability.
A payment processing platform is an always-on utility; processing uptime measures the availability its functions depend on.
BSS runs billing, ordering and customer management for telecom operators; billing accuracy is its canonical operational measure.

system_anchor_metrics.metric_name: Container Image Scan Gate Pass Rate
system_anchor_metrics.rationale: The container orchestration platform archetype admits workloads as schedulable images; the image scan gate pass rate measures the admission hygiene of its scheduling functions.
The ITSM platform archetype commits to service levels for incidents, problems and changes; service level attainment is its canonical service measure.
The mobile core network archetype signs, routes and charges subscriber traffic; core network availability is its canonical operational measure.
The OSS archetype provisions, inventories and assures the network; the cell outage rate measures the network health its functions maintain.
The IoT device management archetype governs device fleets; firmware currency is the canonical fleet-management measure.
The WMS archetype runs inbound, storage and outbound warehouse flows; order picking accuracy is its canonical operational measure.
The cloud data warehouse archetype serves analytical query workloads; p95 query latency is its canonical service measure.
The cloud infrastructure archetype provisions compute, storage and network resources; mean time to provision measures its core fulfilment flow.
The event streaming archetype moves data with bounded freshness; pipeline freshness SLA attainment is its canonical delivery measure.
A financial messaging network carries inter-institutional payment messages inside settlement windows; settlement window compliance is its canonical operational measure.
The MES archetype executes production plans on the shop floor; production plan attainment is its canonical operational measure.
The RAN archetype provides radio capacity; radio access network utilization is its canonical capacity measure.
The card payment network archetype authorizes card transactions; the authorization approval rate is its canonical throughput-quality measure.
The CI/CD platform archetype builds and delivers software changes; CI pipeline success rate is its canonical reliability measure.
The lakehouse archetype unifies storage and analytics under service levels; data platform SLA compliance is its canonical service measure.
The issue tracking archetype manages issue backlogs; the issue aging index is its canonical flow-health measure.
The policy administration archetype issues and services insurance policies; the policy issuance rate is its canonical production measure.
The TMS archetype plans and executes freight movements; on-time delivery is its canonical operational measure.
The claims management archetype runs the claims lifecycle; claims cycle time is its canonical operational measure.
The CPaaS archetype delivers programmatic messages on behalf of applications; first-attempt delivery success is its canonical delivery measure.
The customer service ticketing archetype resolves service cases; first contact resolution is its canonical resolution measure.
The IaC archetype provisions infrastructure from declarative code; infrastructure-as-code coverage is its canonical automation measure.
The workflow orchestration archetype sequences multi-step executions; orchestration success rate is its canonical reliability measure.
The supply chain visibility archetype exposes inventory and movement truth; inventory accuracy is its canonical visibility measure.
The email delivery archetype transmits messaging at scale; deliverability is its canonical delivery measure.
